court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court No.5 at Bandra, Petition No.A-1109/2018

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ariz Kohli, husband, business, 48 years old
parties.respondent_defendant: Tehzeeb Kohli, wife, business, 45 years old

facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent were married in 2002. They have a son born in 2004. The wife filed for divorce due to differences and the husband's alleged extra-marital affair. The trial court allowed an application to amend the petition.

legal_principles.principle: The concept of changing the nature of a suit is not applicable in matrimonial matters.
legal_principles.held: which is applicable to normal proceedings may be inherently foreign to and not applicable in matrimonial matters, where primacy is restoration of normal marital ties, and if not possible, to grant other appropriate relief.
cited_cases: Uttara Praveen Thool Vs. Praveen s/o Bhanudas Thool, (2014) 2 Mh.L.J 321

legal_principles.principle: The principle of amendment of pleadings in routine civil matters is not applicable in matrimonial proceedings.
legal_principles.held: which propound the law on amendment of pleadings in routine civil matters, was held to be inappropriate.
cited_cases: M/s.Revajeetu Builders and Developers vs Narayanaswamy and Sons and ors, (2009) 10 SCC 84

outcome.final_order: The impugned order is set aside, and the matter is remanded back to the Family Court for fresh consideration.
